seo.title: About SolPrompter
seo.description: Meet SolPrompter, the organization behind a free browser-based teleprompter and practical publishing resource for speaking clearly on camera.
seo.ogDescription: Meet SolPrompter, the organization behind our free online teleprompter, editorial guides, and official social channels.

hero.title: The Organization Behind SolPrompter
hero.description: SolPrompter builds and publishes a browser-based teleprompter for people who want to prepare a message, speak clearly on camera, and record without complicated software.

why.title: A Teleprompter Should Support the Speaker
paragraphs: Speaking to a camera is already demanding. A presenter is thinking about the message, the lens, the pace, and the recording while trying to sound like themselves.
We believe the teleprompter should adapt to the speaker, not ask the speaker to adapt to the tool.
That is why SolPrompter brings voice-following scroll, a camera-adjacent reading mode, remote control, scripts, and recording into one browser workspace.

SolPrompter also publishes practical guides on scripts, meetings, interviews, presentations, and speaking on camera. The product and the editorial work share one aim: make prepared communication easier to deliver naturally.

mission.title: Make Professional Presenting Accessible
mission.description: We build a practical teleprompter for people who need to communicate well, from a first recording on a phone to repeatable work for a team or studio.

items.title: Natural Delivery
items.description: Help presenters control their pace and wording without sounding rushed, robotic, or over-rehearsed.

items.title: Better Eye Contact
items.description: Keep the script near the camera so the viewer receives the attention that prepared delivery is meant to create.

items.title: Practical Technology
items.description: Turn useful teleprompter controls into a clear browser experience that works across common devices.

items.title: Open Access
items.description: Keep a capable presenting and recording workflow available without ads or a branded watermark on the finished video.

differences.title: A Connected Speaking Workflow
differences.description: SolPrompter is designed around the work before, during, and after a take, rather than a single scrolling control.

items.title: AI Voice Scroll
items.description: The script follows your speech instead of forcing you to match a fixed scrolling speed.

items.title: Notch Teleprompter Mode
items.description: A compact reading area can be positioned close to the camera to reduce visible eye movement.

items.title: Remote Control
items.description: Control scrolling and navigate your script from another phone, tablet or computer.

items.title: Professional Recording
items.description: Present and record in one workflow with support for Full HD and 4K video on compatible devices.

items.title: Script and Recording Management
items.description: Create, organize and reuse scripts while keeping recordings connected to your content.

items.title: Designed for Every Screen
items.description: Use SolPrompter from a desktop, laptop, tablet or smartphone through a responsive, touch-friendly interface.

items.title: Simple by Default
items.description: The essential action should be clear before a person has read a tutorial or opened a long settings panel.

items.title: Capable When Needed
items.description: More advanced controls should be available when they solve a real delivery or recording problem.

items.title: Natural Delivery First
items.description: Technology should support a presenter’s rhythm, eye line, and attention instead of making delivery feel mechanical.

items.title: Useful Across Devices
items.description: A phone, tablet, laptop, and desktop each need a considered workflow, not the same interface squeezed into a smaller screen.

items.title: Focused Workspaces
items.description: The interface should direct attention to the script, camera, and audience instead of advertisements or decorative noise.

items.title: Respect for Your Work
items.description: Scripts and recordings are the presenter’s work. SolPrompter is built without a branded watermark over exported videos.

audiences.title: For People Preparing to Speak
audiences.description: SolPrompter is for people who want a clear, prepared delivery without memorizing every word or managing a complicated production setup.

items.title: Content Creators
items.description: Record TikTok videos, YouTube videos, Shorts, Reels and talking-head content with a smoother delivery.

items.title: Teachers and Educators
items.description: Create online lessons, course videos and educational presentations while staying focused on the camera.

items.title: Business Professionals
items.description: Prepare company updates, product demos, webinars, training materials and sales presentations.

items.title: Speakers and Presenters
items.description: Practice speeches, follow key talking points and deliver prepared messages with greater confidence.

items.title: Journalists and Interviewers
items.description: Keep questions, introductions and important information visible without repeatedly looking away from the audience.

items.title: Remote Teams
items.description: Use a compact teleprompter during online meetings, interviews, presentations and video calls.

commitment.title: What We Offer Today
paragraphs: SolPrompter is currently free to use. It is built without distracting advertisements or a branded watermark on exported video.
We publish product updates and practical guides so people can understand how the tool works, decide whether it fits their workflow, and prepare a better delivery.
As the product develops, we will keep the same standard: a clear, reliable experience that earns a place in a presenter’s work.

future.title: Developing the Presentation Workspace
paragraphs: The work extends beyond basic teleprompter scrolling.
We are developing SolPrompter as one workspace for preparing a script, presenting it naturally, controlling a session remotely, recording a take, and managing the resulting work.
Future work will focus on useful automation, collaboration, and cross-device workflows that reduce the gap between writing an idea and recording it clearly.
A feature belongs in SolPrompter when it solves a real presentation problem and makes the workflow easier to trust.

ecosystem.title: Product and Editorial Work in One Place
paragraphs: SolPrompter creates a product and a public library of practical guidance for creators, presenters, educators, and professionals.
The guides cover the same work the product supports: writing a script for speaking, preparing a meeting or interview, delivering to camera, and publishing a finished video.
This page is the official source for the organization behind that work and for its public channels.
